line: The ink on this manuscript is still wet—and so, I fear, is the blood!
I did not murder the critic. I merely… edited him out of existence.
Every candle in this house went out at once. That is not a draft. That is a warning.
You dare accuse me? In my own crumbling, obviously-haunted library?
I saw a figure on the stair—wearing YOUR cloak, madam, and it had no face!
Nobody leaves this manor until I find the missing chapter—and the missing heir.
